$comment: Azure Static Web App configuration for the mobile app (Grain Vision's external SPA pattern). SPA fallback for client routes, like Grain Vision's. Security headers per STD-MAA-001 MAA-4.1: connect-src lists the APIM gateways the app calls in Dev, QA and Prod (apidev/apiqa/api.scoular.com) plus Entra sign-in. Recorded deviation from the standard's sample: Permissions-Policy allows geolocation for this origin only, because the farm card's 'Use my location' fills a bin site's coordinates; every other device feature is off. Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy is same-origin because sign-in uses MSAL redirects only (no popups).

globalHeaders.Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' https://login.microsoftonline.com https://apidev.scoular.com https://apiqa.scoular.com https://api.scoular.com; frame-src https://login.microsoftonline.com; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self' https://login.microsoftonline.com; frame-ancestors 'none'; manifest-src 'self'; worker-src 'self'
